source.title: Forebears Ireland forenames and surnames frequency tables

names.notes: Irish name pool refreshed against public frequency tables. Gender buckets remain sample-level because they are not sourced from an official civil registry.

source.title: ComReg review of Irish mobile numbering resources

phones.notes: ComReg identifies the Irish mobile ranges 083, 085, 086, 087 and 089. Generated values omit the domestic trunk 0 after +353 and are not checked for live assignment or portability.

locations.notes: Official Eircode guidance confirms the seven-character postcode structure and three-character routing key. The listed routing keys and generated trailing digits are retained as synthetic test-address placeholders, not address-level Eircode validation.

pps_number.label: PPS Number

source.title: Government of Ireland PPS number service

pps_number.notes: Government guidance confirms a PPS number is seven numbers followed by either one or two letters. No checksum or semantic-letter generation is implemented.

passport_card_number.label: Passport Card Number

source.title: Oireachtas written answer on Irish passport card number format

passport_card_number.notes: Official parliamentary answer confirms Irish passport card numbers start with C followed by eight digits. Generated values are format-only and are not checked against the passport service.
